description.value: Leo's Tapas & Grill has been a community fixture in lower Gibsons since 1999, serving authentic Greek and Mediterranean cuisine including charbroiled dishes, seafood, house-made tapas, and whole-wheat pizzas. The restaurant features summer patio seating in the heart of lower Gibsons, live music and belly dancing on weekend nights, and a full catering service for events. Cyclists finishing a Sunshine Coast ride will find a welcoming, family-oriented atmosphere with dine-in, takeout, and local delivery options.

address.value: 274 Gower Point Road, Gibsons, BC V0N 1V0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content was successfully fetched and is the primary evidence source. The site confirms the address (274 Gower Point Road, Gibsons, BC V0N 1V0) matching OSM, and explicitly states dine-in and takeout service. A phone number discrepancy was found: 604-886-9141 appears once in the contact page body while 604-886-9414 appears prominently in the site header and all footers — 9414 is treated as the authoritative number. No bike-specific amenities (rack, charging, pump, Wi-Fi) are mentioned anywhere on the site; the contact page explicitly states wheelchair accessibility and free parking, and the front page mentions a summer patio.
concerns: Phone number discrepancy on the business's own website: the contact page body lists 604-886-9141, while the site header, front page, and all footers consistently show 604-886-9414. The latter is treated as authoritative but the business should be asked to correct the contact page. OSM has no phone listed.
Bike parking is not mentioned anywhere on the website; this required criterion cannot be confirmed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Leo's is a long-established, actively operating full-service restaurant in lower Gibsons with takeout available — a practical meal stop for touring cyclists on the Sunshine Coast. Bike-specific amenities are unconfirmed but do not disqualify the listing.
enrichment_extras.notes: Website contact page also explicitly states 'Free parking is available and our restaurant is completely wheelchair accessible.' Patio is described as open during summer.
